source: hand-built vectors (RFC 8785 samples, hostile inputs); expect_hex null means the input must be rejected

vectors.note: RFC sample; record profile has no floats
UTF-16 code unit order: U+20AC sorts before U+1F600 (surrogate D83D) before U+FB33; U+FB33 is not NFC-stable, so the record profile rejects it
JCS does not normalise; the record profile rejects non-NFC
both profiles cap nesting at 64 so a verifier cannot be exhausted
overflows to infinity as a double
